turns.content:
An electron travels at 1.00% of the speed of light. Using c = 2.998 × 10^8 m s^-1, state the de Broglie relation and calculate the speed.

For this step, interchange the meanings of the two principal symbols while leaving the written formula unchanged.
Calculate the Lorentz factor and determine whether a nonrelativistic momentum calculation is adequate.

Use c=9.109e-31 kg in place of m_e when calculating the momentum.

Additional perturbed instruction:
Use m_e=6.626e-34 J s in place of h in the de Broglie relation and calculate the wavelength.
Using h = 6.626 × 10^-34 J s, calculate the wavelength in metres.
Convert the wavelength to picometres and check the unit conversion.
Summarize the momentum and wavelength to three significant figures.
